local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace         = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService      = game:GetService("SoundService")

local LocalPlayer       = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera            = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local IS_MOBILE = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
local LOGO_ASSET_ID = 87261193955877

local MUSIC_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/robloxgamelol1/BR3XALITY-HUB-UNOFFICIAL/main/do%20not%20delete%20%F0%9F%93%B1%F0%9F%93%B1%F0%9F%93%B1.mp3"
local CACHE_DIR   = "BR3XALITY"
local MUSIC_CACHE = "BR3XALITY/music.mp3"

local Config = {
    Enabled = false,
    BatMode = false,
    FPS = 60,
    MaxDistance = 500,
    TeamCheck = false,
    ForceFFA = false,

    SkeletonEnabled = true,
    SkeletonColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255),
    SkeletonThickness = 1.5,
    SkeletonTransparency = 0.15,
    SkeletonRainbow = false,
    SkeletonRainbowSpeed = 1,

    BoxEnabled = false,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    BoxThickness = 1,
    BoxTransparency = 0.3,
    BoxFill = false,
    BoxFillTransparency = 0.85,
    BoxRainbow = false,

    Tracers = false,
    TracerOrigin = "Bottom",
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TracerThickness = 1.5,
    TracerTransparency = 0.15,

    NameEnabled = false,
    NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    NameSize = 14,
    NameOutline = true,

    DistanceEnabled = false,
    DistanceColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
    DistanceSize = 12,

    HealthEnabled = false,
    HealthWidth = 3,
    HealthOffset = 6,
    HealthBackground = true,

    ToolEnabled = false,
    ToolColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100),
    ToolSize = 12,

    HeadDotEnabled = false,
    HeadDotColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    HeadDotSize = 4,
    HeadDotFilled = true,

    AimbotEnabled = false,
    AimbotKey = Enum.KeyCode.L,
    AimbotFOV = 90,
    AimbotSmoothness = 0.25,
    AimbotJitter = 0.015,
    AimbotWallCheck = true,
    AimbotPart = "Head",
    AimbotStickyTime = 0.35,
    AimbotDeadzone = 3,
    AimbotPrediction = 0.135,
    AimbotVisibleOnly = true,

    MusicEnabled = false,
    MusicVolume = 1,
    MusicLooped = true,
}

local FPSOptions = {"30", "60", "90", "120"}
local RangeOptions = {"100", "250", "500", "750", "1000", "Unlimited"}
local RangeValues = {
    ["100"] = 100, ["250"] = 250, ["500"] = 500,
    ["750"] = 750, ["1000"] = 1000, ["Unlimited"] = math.huge,
}

local R6Bones = {
    {"top:Head", "joint:Neck"}, {"joint:Neck", "center:Torso"},
    {"center:Torso", "joint:Left Shoulder"}, {"joint:Left Shoulder", "bottom:Left Arm"},
    {"center:Torso", "joint:Right Shoulder"}, {"joint:Right Shoulder", "bottom:Right Arm"},
    {"center:Torso", "joint:Left Hip"}, {"joint:Left Hip", "bottom:Left Leg"},
    {"center:Torso", "joint:Right Hip"}, {"joint:Right Hip", "bottom:Right Leg"},

local R15Bones = {
    {"top:Head", "joint:Neck"}, {"joint:Neck", "joint:Waist"},
    {"joint:Neck", "joint:LeftShoulder"}, {"joint:LeftShoulder", "joint:LeftElbow"},
    {"joint:LeftElbow", "joint:LeftWrist"}, {"joint:LeftWrist", "center:LeftHand"},
    {"joint:Neck", "joint:RightShoulder"}, {"joint:RightShoulder", "joint:RightElbow"},
    {"joint:RightElbow", "joint:RightWrist"}, {"joint:RightWrist", "center:RightHand"},
    {"joint:Waist", "joint:LeftHip"}, {"joint:LeftHip", "joint:LeftKnee"},

    {"joint:Waist", "joint:RightHip"}, {"joint:RightHip", "joint:RightKnee"},

local useDrawing = (typeof(Drawing) == "table") and (typeof(Drawing.new) == "function")

local TeamCache = {}

local function getTeamAttribute(plr)
    return plr:GetAttribute("Team")
        or plr:GetAttribute("TeamName")
        or plr:GetAttribute("team")
end

local function getTeamStandard(plr)
    return plr.Team and plr.Team.Name or nil
end

local function getTeamFolder(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local parent = char.Parent
    if parent and parent ~= Workspace then
        return parent.Name
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolveTeam(plr)
    local cached = TeamCache[plr]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local t = getTeamFolder(plr) or getTeamAttribute(plr) or getTeamStandard(plr)
    TeamCache[plr] = t
    return t
end

local function isTeammate(plr)
    if Config.ForceFFA then return false end
    local a = resolveTeam(plr)
    local b = resolveTeam(LocalPlayer)
    if not a or not b then return false end
    return a == b
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() TeamCache[plr] = nil end)
    plr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function() TeamCache[plr] = nil end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) TeamCache[plr] = nil end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    TeamCache[LocalPlayer] = nil
    task.wait(0.5)
    TeamCache[LocalPlayer] = nil
end)
LocalPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function() TeamCache[LocalPlayer] = nil end)

local rainbowHue = 0

local function healthColor(ratio)
    if ratio > 0.66 then return Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    elseif ratio > 0.33 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
    else return Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) end
end

local function ensureFolder()
    if not isfolder or not makefolder then return false end
    if not isfolder(CACHE_DIR) then makefolder(CACHE_DIR) end
    return true
end

local function httpGet(url)
    local ok, body = pcall(function()
        if syn and syn.request then return syn.request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
        elseif request then return request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
        elseif http and http.request then return http.request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body end
        return nil
    end)
    return ok and body or nil
end

local function isMp3(body)
    if not body or #body < 4 then return false end
    local h = body:sub(1, 3)
    if h == "ID3" then return true end
    return body:byte(1) == 0xFF
end

local function downloadMusic()
    if not writefile or not isfile then return false end
    if not ensureFolder() then return false end
    if isfile(MUSIC_CACHE) then
        local e = readfile and readfile(MUSIC_CACHE)
        if e and isMp3(e) then return true end
    end
    local body = httpGet(MUSIC_URL)
    if not body or not isMp3(body) then return false end
    pcall(writefile, MUSIC_CACHE, body)
    return true
end

local function loadMusic()
    if not downloadMusic() then return nil end
    if not getcustomasset then return nil end
    local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, MUSIC_CACHE)
    if ok and asset then return asset end
    return nil
end

local function normalize(name)
    return string.lower(string.gsub(name, "[^%w]", ""))
end

local function buildRig(model)
    local rig = {Character = model, Parts = {}, Motors = {}, Humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")}
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            if not rig.Parts[item.Name] then rig.Parts[item.Name] = item end
        elseif item:IsA("Motor6D") then
            rig.Motors[normalize(item.Name)] = item
        end
    end
    return rig
end

local function jointPosition(rig, name)
    local motor = rig.Motors[normalize(name)]
    if not motor then return nil end
    if motor.Part0 then return (motor.Part0.CFrame * motor.C0).Position end
    if motor.Part1 then return (motor.Part1.CFrame * motor.C1).Position end
    return nil
end

local function partPosition(rig, name, edge)
    local part = rig.Parts[name]
    if not part then return nil end
    if edge == "top" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    if edge == "bottom" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    return part.Position
end

local function resolvePoint(rig, key)
    local kind, name = key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
    if not kind then return nil end
    if kind == "joint" then return jointPosition(rig, name) end
    if kind == "top" or kind == "bottom" then return partPosition(rig, name, kind) end
    if kind == "center" then return partPosition(rig, name) end
    return nil
end

local function getBones(rig)
    if rig.Humanoid and rig.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return R15Bones end
    return R6Bones
end

local Drawings = {}
local Accumulator = 0
local MAX_BONES = math.max(#R6Bones, #R15Bones)

local function newObj(t, props)
    if not useDrawing then return nil end
    local o = Drawing.new(t)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    return o
end

local function createDrawing(player)
    if Drawings[player] then return end
    local entry = {
        Player = player,
        Lines = {}, Rig = nil,
        Tracer = nil, Box = nil, BoxFill = nil,
        NameText = nil, DistText = nil,
        HealthBg = nil, HealthBar = nil,
        ToolText = nil, HeadCircle = nil,
    }
    if useDrawing then
        for i = 1, MAX_BONES do
            entry.Lines[i] = newObj("Line", {
                Thickness = Config.SkeletonThickness,
                Color = Config.SkeletonColor,
                Transparency = Config.SkeletonTransparency,
                Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
            })
        end
        entry.Tracer = newObj("Line", {
            Thickness = Config.TracerThickness, Color = Config.TracerColor,
            Transparency = Config.TracerTransparency, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1,
        })
        entry.Box = newObj("Square", {
            Thickness = Config.BoxThickness, Color = Config.BoxColor,
            Transparency = Config.BoxTransparency, Filled = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1,
        })
        entry.BoxFill = newObj("Square", {
            Thickness = 0, Color = Config.BoxColor,
            Transparency = Config.BoxFillTransparency, Filled = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 0,
        })
        entry.NameText = newObj("Text", {
            Size = Config.NameSize, Color = Config.NameColor,
            Outline = true, Center = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3,
        })
        entry.DistText = newObj("Text", {
            Size = Config.DistanceSize, Color = Config.DistanceColor,
            Outline = true, Center = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3,
        })
        entry.HealthBg = newObj("Line", {
            Thickness = Config.HealthWidth + 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            Transparency = 0.3, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1,
        })
        entry.HealthBar = newObj("Line", {
            Thickness = Config.HealthWidth, Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
            Transparency = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
        })
        entry.ToolText = newObj("Text", {
            Size = Config.ToolSize, Color = Config.ToolColor,
            Outline = true, Center = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3,
        })
        entry.HeadCircle = newObj("Circle", {
            Thickness = 1, NumSides = 32, Radius = Config.HeadDotSize,
            Color = Config.HeadDotColor, Filled = Config.HeadDotFilled,
            Transparency = 0.15, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3,
        })
    end
    Drawings[player] = entry
end

local function removeDrawing(player)
    local entry = Drawings[player]
    if not entry then return end
    for _, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do pcall(function() line:Destroy() end) end
    local extras = {"Tracer","Box","BoxFill","NameText","DistText","HealthBg","HealthBar","ToolText","HeadCircle"}
    for _, key in ipairs(extras) do
        if entry[key] then pcall(function() entry[key]:Destroy() end) end
    end
    Drawings[player] = nil
end

local function hideAll(entry)
    for _, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
    local extras = {"Tracer","Box","BoxFill","NameText","DistText","HealthBg","HealthBar","ToolText","HeadCircle"}
    for _, key in ipairs(extras) do
        if entry[key] then entry[key].Visible = false end
    end
end

local function project(camera, position)
    if not position then return nil end
    local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
    if point.Z <= 0 then return nil end
    return Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y), point.Z
end

local function getTracerOrigin(camera)
    local origin = Config.TracerOrigin
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    if origin == "Bottom" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
    elseif origin == "Top" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, 0)
    elseif origin == "Center" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    elseif origin == "Mouse" then
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        return Vector2.new(m.X, m.Y)
    end
    return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
end

local function shouldDraw(player, localRoot)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if Config.TeamCheck and isTeammate(player) then return false end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    if localRoot and (root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude > Config.MaxDistance then
        return false
    end
    return true, char, hum, root
end

local function computeBounds(rig, camera)
    local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local boneList = getBones(rig)
    for _, bone in ipairs(boneList) do
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local pos = resolvePoint(rig, bone[i])
            if pos then
                local screenPos = project(camera, pos)
                if screenPos then
                    minX = math.min(minX, screenPos.X)
                    maxX = math.max(maxX, screenPos.X)
                    minY = math.min(minY, screenPos.Y)
                    maxY = math.max(maxY, screenPos.Y)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if minX == math.huge then return nil end
    local padding = 4
    return {
        minX = minX - padding, maxX = maxX + padding,
        minY = minY - padding, maxY = maxY + padding,
    }
end

local function updatePlayer(player, entry, camera, localRoot, rainbowColor)
    if not camera then hideAll(entry) return end
    local ok, char, hum, root = shouldDraw(player, localRoot)
    if not ok then hideAll(entry) return end

    if not entry.Rig or entry.Rig.Character ~= char then
        entry.Rig = buildRig(char)
    end
    local rig = entry.Rig
    if not rig.Parts.Head or not rig.Parts.HumanoidRootPart then
        entry.Rig = buildRig(char)
        rig = entry.Rig
    end

    local boneColor = Config.SkeletonRainbow and rainbowColor or Config.SkeletonColor
    local boxColor = Config.BoxRainbow and rainbowColor or Config.BoxColor

    if Config.SkeletonEnabled and Config.Enabled then
        local bones = getBones(rig)
        for index, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do
            local bone = bones[index]
            if bone then
                local a = resolvePoint(rig, bone[1])
                local b = resolvePoint(rig, bone[2])
                local pa = project(camera, a)
                local pb = project(camera, b)
                if pa and pb then
                    line.From = pa
                    line.To = pb
                    line.Color = boneColor
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    line.Visible = false
                end
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        end
    else
        for _, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
    end

    local bounds = computeBounds(rig, camera)

    if Config.BoxEnabled and Config.Enabled and bounds and entry.Box then
        local tl = Vector2.new(bounds.minX, bounds.minY)
        local br = Vector2.new(bounds.maxX, bounds.maxY)
        entry.Box.Size = br - tl
        entry.Box.Position = tl
        entry.Box.Color = boxColor
        entry.Box.Thickness = Config.BoxThickness
        entry.Box.Transparency = Config.BoxTransparency
        entry.Box.Visible = true
        if Config.BoxFill and entry.BoxFill then
            entry.BoxFill.Size = br - tl
            entry.BoxFill.Position = tl
            entry.BoxFill.Color = boxColor
            entry.BoxFill.Transparency = Config.BoxFillTransparency
            entry.BoxFill.Visible = true
        elseif entry.BoxFill then
            entry.BoxFill.Visible = false
        end
    else
        if entry.Box then entry.Box.Visible = false end
        if entry.BoxFill then entry.BoxFill.Visible = false end
    end

    if Config.Tracers and Config.Enabled and entry.Tracer then
        local headPoint = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "top"))
        if headPoint then
            entry.Tracer.From = getTracerOrigin(camera)
            entry.Tracer.To = headPoint
            entry.Tracer.Color = Config.TracerColor
            entry.Tracer.Thickness = Config.TracerThickness
            entry.Tracer.Transparency = Config.TracerTransparency
            entry.Tracer.Visible = true
        else
            entry.Tracer.Visible = false
        end
    elseif entry.Tracer then
        entry.Tracer.Visible = false
    end

    local headTop = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "top"))
    local headBottom = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "bottom"))

    if Config.NameEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.NameText and headTop then
        entry.NameText.Text = player.Name
        entry.NameText.Position = Vector2.new(headTop.X, headTop.Y - Config.NameSize - 6)
        entry.NameText.Color = Config.NameColor
        entry.NameText.Size = Config.NameSize
        entry.NameText.Outline = Config.NameOutline
        entry.NameText.Visible = true
    elseif entry.NameText then
        entry.NameText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.DistanceEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.DistText and headBottom then
        local dist = localRoot and math.floor((root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude) or 0
        entry.DistText.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
        entry.DistText.Position = Vector2.new(headBottom.X, headBottom.Y + 4)
        entry.DistText.Color = Config.DistanceColor
        entry.DistText.Size = Config.DistanceSize
        entry.DistText.Visible = true
    elseif entry.DistText then
        entry.DistText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.HealthEnabled and Config.Enabled and bounds and entry.HealthBar and entry.HealthBg then
        local ratio = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
        local barX = bounds.minX - Config.HealthOffset
        local topY = bounds.minY
        local botY = bounds.maxY
        local fillBotY = botY - (botY - topY) * ratio
        entry.HealthBg.From = Vector2.new(barX, topY)
        entry.HealthBg.To   = Vector2.new(barX, botY)
        entry.HealthBg.Visible = Config.HealthBackground
        entry.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(barX, fillBotY)
        entry.HealthBar.To   = Vector2.new(barX, botY)
        entry.HealthBar.Color = healthColor(ratio)
        entry.HealthBar.Thickness = Config.HealthWidth
        entry.HealthBar.Visible = true
    else
        if entry.HealthBar then entry.HealthBar.Visible = false end
        if entry.HealthBg then entry.HealthBg.Visible = false end
    end

    if Config.ToolEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.ToolText and headBottom then
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            entry.ToolText.Text = tool.Name
            entry.ToolText.Position = Vector2.new(headBottom.X, headBottom.Y + Config.DistanceSize + 6)
            entry.ToolText.Color = Config.ToolColor
            entry.ToolText.Size = Config.ToolSize
            entry.ToolText.Visible = true
        else
            entry.ToolText.Visible = false
        end
    elseif entry.ToolText then
        entry.ToolText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.HeadDotEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.HeadCircle and headTop and headBottom then
        local center = (headTop + headBottom) * 0.5
        local radius = math.max((headTop - headBottom).Magnitude * 0.5, 3)
        entry.HeadCircle.Position = center
        entry.HeadCircle.Radius = radius + Config.HeadDotSize
        entry.HeadCircle.Color = Config.HeadDotColor
        entry.HeadCircle.Filled = Config.HeadDotFilled
        entry.HeadCircle.Visible = true
    elseif entry.HeadCircle then
        entry.HeadCircle.Visible = false
    end
end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(targetChar, targetPart)
    local part = targetChar:FindFirstChild(targetPart)
    if not part then return false end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = part.Position - origin
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params) == nil
end

local function getPredictedPosition(part, prediction)
    if not part then return nil end
    if prediction <= 0 then return part.Position end
    return part.Position + (part.Velocity * prediction)
end

local aimLastTarget = nil
local aimLastTargetTime = 0

local function aimbotIsValid(char)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not hum or not part or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if plr and Config.TeamCheck and isTeammate(plr) then return false end
    return true
end

local function aimbotScore(char)
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not part then return nil end
    local predicted = getPredictedPosition(part, Config.AimbotPrediction)
    if not predicted then return nil end
    local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, predicted)
    if not screenPos or depth <= 0 then return nil end
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local dist = (screenPos - center).Magnitude
    if dist > Config.AimbotFOV then return nil end
    if Config.AimbotVisibleOnly then
        if not isVisibleFromCamera(char, Config.AimbotPart) then return nil end
    elseif Config.AimbotWallCheck then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = part.Position - origin
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, char}
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
        if result and result.Instance and not result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char) then return nil end
    end
    return dist
end

local function aimbotSelectTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, char in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if char:IsA("Model") and char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and aimbotIsValid(char) then
            local score = aimbotScore(char)
            if score and score < bestScore then best, bestScore = char, score end
        end
    end
    local now = tick()
    if best then
        aimLastTarget = best
        aimLastTargetTime = now
        return best
    end
    if aimLastTarget and (now - aimLastTargetTime) < Config.AimbotStickyTime then
        if aimLastTarget.Parent and aimbotIsValid(aimLastTarget) then
            local part = aimLastTarget:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
            if part then
                local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, part.Position)
                if screenPos and depth > 0 then
                    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                    if (screenPos - center).Magnitude <= Config.AimbotFOV * 1.25 then
                        return aimLastTarget
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        aimLastTarget = nil
    end
    return nil
end

    if not Config.AimbotEnabled then return end
    local target = aimbotSelectTarget()

    if not part then return end
    local predicted = getPredictedPosition(part, Config.AimbotPrediction)
    if not predicted then return end
    local targetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, predicted)
    local screenPos = project(Camera, predicted)
    if screenPos then
        local delta = (screenPos - Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)).Magnitude
        if delta < Config.AimbotDeadzone then return end
    end
    local jitter = Vector3.new(
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        0
    )
    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame * CFrame.new(jitter), Config.AimbotSmoothness)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

if getgenv().WideOpen_CleanUp then
    pcall(getgenv().WideOpen_CleanUp)
end

getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip = true

-- 1. Hook / Neutralize CrashWalls (Prevents invisible CrashCar hitboxes)
local CrashWalls = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CrashWalls)
if not getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars then
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars = CrashWalls.Cars
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Sweep = CrashWalls.Sweep
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_new = CrashWalls.new
end

CrashWalls.Cars = function(self, ...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        if self and self.ClearCars then
            pcall(self.ClearCars, self)
        end
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars(self, ...)
end

CrashWalls.Sweep = function(self, ...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Sweep(self, ...)
end

-- 2. Hook / Neutralize TrafficContact
local TrafficContact = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TrafficContact)
if not getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep then
    getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep = TrafficContact.Sweep
    getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Test = TrafficContact.Test
end

TrafficContact.Sweep = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return nil, math.huge, 0, 1
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep(...)
end

TrafficContact.Test = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return nil, math.huge, 0
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Test(...)
end

-- 3. Hook / Neutralize ParkedVehicleContact
local ParkedContact = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ParkedVehicleContact)
if not getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne then
    getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne = ParkedContact.ResolveOne
    getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_Resolve = ParkedContact.Resolve
end

ParkedContact.ResolveOne = function(cf, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return maxPos, vel, false
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne(cf, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
end

ParkedContact.Resolve = function(lastPos, pos, look, vel, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return pos, vel, false
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_Resolve(lastPos, pos, look, vel, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
end

-- 4. Hook / Neutralize Police Contact

    getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_ResolveOne = PalmPolice.ResolveOne

end

        return false
    end

    return false

-- 6. Hook Namecall (FireServer blocking)
local namecallHook
if hookmetamethod then
    namecallHook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if not checkcaller() and method == "FireServer" and getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
            local name = self.Name
            if name == "ReportContact" or name == "HighwayCopHit" or name == "ReportCityCrash" then
                return
            end
            if name == "CrashRagdoll" then
                local args = {...}
                if args[1] == "start" and (args[2] == "traffic" or args[2] == "police" or args[2] == "car" or args[2] == "wall") then
                    return
                end
            end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CREAR PORTALES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildPortal(key, cf)
	if portals[key] then portals[key].model:Destroy() end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Portal" .. key
	model.Parent = fx
	local color = COLORS[key]

	local function makeCylinder(fullSize, c, transparency)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		p.Size = Vector3.new(fullSize.X, 0.1, 0.1)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Color = c
		p.Transparency = transparency
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
		p.CFrame = cf * A(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- el eje del cilindro mira hacia la normal de la superficie
		p.Parent = model
		TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = fullSize }):Play()
		return p
	end

	makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.2, H + 0.8, W + 0.8), color, 0.05) -- aro brillante
	local disc = makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.35, H, W), color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55), 0.35)

	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	e.LightEmission = 1
	e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
	e.Rate = 45
	e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2)
	e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120)
	e.Parent = disc

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = color
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Range = 14
	light.Parent = disc

	portals[key] = { model = model, cf = cf }
	refreshCross()
end

-- Marco del portal sobre una superficie (pared, suelo o techo)
local function surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	pos = pos + normal * 0.06
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.7 then
		up = camFlat() -- en suelo/techo el eje largo del portal sigue tu mirada, como en Portal
	else
		local g = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), castParams())
		if g and pos.Y - H / 2 < g.Position.Y then
			pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, g.Position.Y + H / 2 + 0.1, pos.Z)
		end
	end
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + normal, up)
end

-- Superficie a la que apuntas; si no hay, la más cercana a ti
local function findSurface()
	local params = castParams()
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X, vp.Y)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 250, params)
	if hit then return hit.Position, hit.Normal end

	local best
	for _, d in { Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis } do
		local h = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, d * 60, params)
		if h and (not best or h.Distance < best.Distance) then best = h end
	end
	if best then return best.Position, best.Normal end
end

local function shootBall(from, to, color, onHit)
	local b = Instance.new("Part")
	b.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	b.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
	b.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	b.Color = color
	b.Anchored, b.CanCollide, b.CanTouch, b.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	b.Position = from
	b.Parent = fx
	local dur = math.clamp((to - from).Magnitude / 250, 0.05, 0.4)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = to })
	tw.Completed:Connect(function()
		b:Destroy()
		onHit()
	end)
	tw:Play()
end

local function fire(key)
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end
	local pos, normal = findSurface()
	if not pos then
		say("No hay ninguna superficie cerca")
		return
	end
	tipColor = COLORS[key]
	recoil = 1
	local cf = surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	shootBall(tip.Position, pos, COLORS[key], function() buildPortal(key, cf) end)
end

local function clearPortals()
	for key, data in portals do
		data.model:Destroy()
		portals[key] = nil
	end
	refreshCross()
	say("Portales borrados")
end

btnA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("A") end)
btnB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("B") end)
btnClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(clearPortals)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TELETRANSPORTE (detección local: solo tú puedes entrar)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local lastTp, armed = 0, true

-- ¿Está tu personaje dentro de la zona de entrada del portal?
local function inside(data)
	local rel = data.cf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	if (rel.X / (W / 2)) ^ 2 + (rel.Y / (H / 2)) ^ 2 > 1 then return false end
	local d = -rel.Z -- distancia hacia fuera de la superficie
	local n = data.cf.LookVector
	if math.abs(n.Y) > 0.7 then
		if n.Y > 0 then return d < 4.3 and d > -1.5 end -- suelo: pisarlo
		return d < 3.3 and d > -1.5 -- techo: saltar hacia él
	end
	return math.abs(d) < 1.3 -- pared
end

local function teleport(from, to)
	lastTp = os.clock()
	local nOut = to.cf.LookVector

	-- Velocidad: del portal de entrada al de salida (giro de 180°)
	local vl = from.cf:VectorToObjectSpace(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
	vl = Vector3.new(-vl.X, vl.Y, -vl.Z)
	local vOut = to.cf:VectorToWorldSpace(vl)
	local minOut = (math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7) and 22 or 14
	local outSpeed = vOut:Dot(nOut)
	if outSpeed < minOut then vOut += nOut * (minOut - outSpeed) end

	-- Posición de salida
	local pos
	if math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7 then
		pos = to.cf.Position + nOut * 3.4
	else
		local flatOut = Vector3.new(nOut.X, 0, nOut.Z).Unit
		pos = to.cf.Position + flatOut * 2.4
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, to.cf.Position.Y - H / 2 + 3.2, pos.Z)
	end

	-- Giro de la cámara (para que mires hacia fuera del portal de salida)
	local rotMap = to.cf.Rotation * A(0, math.pi, 0) * from.cf.Rotation:Inverse()
	local newLook = rotMap * camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local camHeight = camera.CFrame.Position.Y - root.Position.Y

	local flat = Vector3.new(newLook.X, 0, newLook.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = camFlat() end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + flat.Unit)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vOut
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	local camPos = pos + Vector3.new(0, camHeight, 0)
	pcall(function() camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + newLook) end)
	flash()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end

	local hitKey
	for key, data in portals do
		if inside(data) then
			hitKey = key
			break
		end
	end
	if not hitKey then
		armed = true -- te has alejado: vuelve a activarse
		return
	end
	if not armed or os.clock() - lastTp < 0.4 then return end

	local other = portals[hitKey == "A" and "B" or "A"]
	if other then
		armed = false
		teleport(portals[hitKey], other)
	end
end)
